Staff meal plans for companies in Dubai

By the Messify team · Updated November 2026 · 4 min read

Quick answer

A company meal plan gives every employee a proper meal for one predictable bill. On Messify monthly plans, lunch for one employee costs AED 715 a month (AED 27.50 a meal), so lunch for a team of 10 costs AED 7,150 a month. Each employee picks their own meals in the app, and meals arrive chilled at the workplace.

Why companies pay for staff meals

Feeding staff used to mean a canteen or a cash allowance. For most companies in Dubai, neither fits: a canteen needs space, licences and staff, and an allowance disappears into delivery apps without anyone eating better. A company meal plan sits in between. The company pays one predictable bill, every employee gets a proper meal, and nobody loses half the lunch break waiting for a rider.

It matters most where food options are thin: free zones, industrial areas, warehouses, logistics sites and new business districts such as Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and Dubai South.

Three ways to set up staff meals

  • Food allowance. Simple to run, but the money is spent on whatever is easiest, and there's no control over quality or cost.
  • On-site canteen. Good for very large sites, but expensive to set up and run.
  • Company meal plan. Meals for each employee, chosen ahead in an app and delivered to the workplace. One plan, one bill, no kitchen to run.

What staff meals cost

On Messify monthly plans, lunch for one employee is AED 715 a month (26 days of meals, AED 27.50 a meal). Lunch and dinner is AED 1,400 a month (AED 26.92 a meal). Here is what that means for a team:

Monthly cost of staff meals on Messify monthly plans (AED, 26 days of meals per person)
Team sizeLunch only (1 meal a day)Lunch and dinner (2 meals a day)
5 employeesAED 3,575AED 7,000
10 employeesAED 7,150AED 14,000

Every employee's meals are tokens they can skip and use later in the plan, so leave and site visits don't waste money. For shorter projects or trial runs, weekly plans start at AED 215 per person.

How a company meal plan works with Messify

  1. Tell us your team size, location and start date on WhatsApp.
  2. Each employee chooses their meals in the Messify app from a menu that changes every day, with a vegetarian option every day, for every meal. Orders are placed at least a day ahead.
  3. Meals are delivered to your workplace chilled, in Messify bags with ice packs, ready for the fridge.
  4. Staff reheat at lunch. Meals are blast-chilled after cooking, so a few minutes in the microwave is all it takes.

Every meal is 100% halal and cooked fresh daily in our partner kitchen in International City.

What to sort before you start

  • Fridge and microwave space for the whole team.
  • Delivery access: gate passes, loading bays or reception rules at your building.
  • A point of contact who receives the delivery.
  • Dietary needs: vegetarian and allergy needs are handled by each person choosing their own meals.
  • Budget rules: lunch only, or lunch and dinner for staff who live on site.

Questions people ask

How much do staff meals cost per employee in Dubai?

On Messify monthly plans, lunch for one employee costs AED 715 a month (AED 27.50 a meal) and lunch and dinner costs AED 1,400 a month (AED 26.92 a meal).

Can a company pay for employee meal plans?

Yes. Teams can share one monthly plan with one delivery for everyone, and each employee chooses their own meals in the app. Message us on WhatsApp with your team size and location.

What happens when an employee is on leave?

Every meal is a token. Skip the days in the app and use those meals later in the plan. Monthly plans give 30 days to use 26 days of meals.

Which areas do you deliver staff meals to?

Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai Festival City, International City, Al Aweer, Dubai Investments Park, Jebel Ali and JAFZA, Dubai South, Academic City and Al Furjan.

Are staff meals halal?

Yes. Every Messify meal is 100% halal, with a vegetarian option every day, for every meal.
